messages.form.note.no-responses-dataset: No responses yet. Save as a dataset once responses arrive.
messages.form.note.stopped: Collection stopped. Existing responses are kept; the fill-in page no longer accepts submissions, but you can still import response files.
messages.form.page.title: Form
messages.form.preview.empty: No questions yet. Go back to Edit and add one.
messages.form.project-deletion.data: Forms and every answer they received
messages.form.try.hint: Try it yourself first; your submission counts in the results, marked as a test
messages.form.try.label: Test fill
messages.form.cap.answers-import.description: Import response files from exported fill-in pages, skipping duplicates and invalid files with reasons and marking them as file imports. While in draft or stopped, only your local manual import is allowed; assistant, workflow, plugin, and MCP imports are rejected.
messages.form.cap.answers-import.title: Import response files
messages.form.cap.artifacts-compare.description: Check whether a saved version in Artifacts matches the current form. Read-only.
messages.form.cap.artifacts-compare.title: Compare saved and current form
messages.form.cap.artifacts-continue.description: Create a new editable form from a saved version in Artifacts. The saved version stays unchanged.
messages.form.cap.artifacts-continue.title: New form from saved version
messages.form.cap.artifacts-pin.description: Save the current form as a new fixed version in Artifacts. You can keep editing the original, and the saved version won’t change.
messages.form.cap.artifacts-pin.title: Pin current form version
messages.form.cap.artifacts-preview.description: Turn a saved version of a form into a readable preview for Artifacts, the sidebar, or starting a workflow. Read-only.
messages.form.cap.artifacts-preview.title: Preview form
messages.form.cap.close.description: Stop accepting new responses from the local fill-in page, assistant, workflows, plugins, and MCP (except your own local test fills and manual imports). Existing responses are kept, and you can start collecting again anytime.
messages.form.cap.close.title: Stop collecting responses
messages.form.cap.content-create.description: Create a blank form to receive content from later workflow steps.
messages.form.cap.content-create.title: Create blank handoff form
messages.form.cap.content-list.description: List forms available to select and pass along in a workflow. Read-only.
messages.form.cap.content-list.title: List handoff forms
messages.form.cap.content-read.description: Read the content of a selected form to pass to the next workflow step. Read-only.
messages.form.cap.content-read.title: Read handoff form
messages.form.cap.content-receive.description: Write content handed off from an earlier workflow step into a form.
messages.form.cap.content-receive.title: Receive form content
messages.form.cap.create.description: Create a new draft form in the current project without saving it as an Artifact. Use “Edit form” to add questions.
messages.form.cap.create.title: Create form
messages.form.cap.delete.description: Permanently delete a form along with all its collected responses. This can’t be undone, and any unfinished Artifact save must be resolved first.
messages.form.cap.delete.title: Delete form
messages.form.cap.fillpage.description: Generate a standalone offline HTML fill-in page to send to others so they can fill it out in a browser and send back a response file. Nothing is uploaded online.
messages.form.cap.fillpage.title: Export fill-in page
messages.form.cap.get.description: Read a form’s questions, options, collection status, current version, and Artifact status. Read-only.
messages.form.cap.get.title: Read form
messages.form.cap.list.description: List all forms in the current project and check whether AI question drafting is available. Read-only.
messages.form.cap.list.title: List forms
messages.form.cap.placement-copy.description: Copy a form to personal space or another project. Changes to either copy won’t affect the other.
messages.form.cap.placement-copy.title: Copy form
messages.form.cap.placement-move.description: Move a form to personal space or another project while keeping the same content and identity.
messages.form.cap.placement-move.title: Move form
messages.form.cap.promote.description: Save the current form design as a fixed version in Artifacts without including responses. You can keep editing the form.
messages.form.cap.promote.title: Save form to Artifacts
messages.form.cap.publish.description: Start collecting responses on this computer through the local fill-in page or exported fill-in page files. Assistant, workflow, plugin, and MCP submissions or imports are only accepted while collecting. No public link or Artifact is created.
messages.form.cap.publish.title: Start collecting responses
messages.form.cap.questions-add.description: Append a short-answer question using the text you provide. Handled locally without calling an AI model.
messages.form.cap.questions-add.title: Add question
messages.form.cap.questions-draft.description: Ask the configured text model to draft and append questions based on your request. If more detail is needed, it asks a few multiple-choice questions first before generating. Nothing is saved if the call fails or the form changes.
messages.form.cap.questions-draft.title: Draft questions with AI
messages.form.cap.results-csv.description: Export all collected responses into a CSV spreadsheet with submission time and source, ready to open in Excel or Numbers. Read-only.
messages.form.cap.results-csv.title: Export responses as CSV
messages.form.cap.results.description: Read collected responses and response counts. Newer responses keep the exact questions asked at submission, while older responses without saved questions stay as-is without guessing. Read-only.
messages.form.cap.results.title: Read responses
messages.form.cap.search-entries.description: List searchable forms in batches so search can build and update its index. Read-only.
messages.form.cap.search-entries.title: List searchable forms
messages.form.cap.subject-read.description: Read a form’s current content, version, and linked items for explicit reference. Read-only.
messages.form.cap.subject-read.title: Read form details and links
messages.form.cap.submit.description: Submit answers for the form’s current questions, truthfully recording where they came from and avoiding duplicates on retry. Regular fill-in pages, the assistant, workflows, plugins, and MCP can submit only while collecting; otherwise only your local test fill is allowed.
messages.form.cap.submit.title: Submit response
messages.form.cap.update.description: Update a form’s title, details, or question list. Checks the version you read to avoid overwriting other edits.
messages.form.cap.update.title: Edit form
messages.form.permission.artifact-read.reason: Read saved form versions for numbering or recovering an unfinished save
messages.form.permission.artifact-write.reason: Save forms as fixed versions in Artifacts
messages.form.permission.form-read.reason: Read forms, questions, and collected responses in the current project
messages.form.permission.form-submit.reason: Submit responses or import response files into forms in the current project
messages.form.permission.form-write.reason: Create, edit, or delete forms, and start or stop collecting responses
messages.form.permission.model-invoke.reason: Call your configured text model when you explicitly ask AI to draft form questions
messages.form.permission.storage-private.reason: Store the current project’s forms and collected responses on this computer
